title: Topic 6.2: Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour

pages.lesson:
LESSON: HUMAN SEXUALITY: RESPONSIBLE SEXUAL BEHAVIOUR

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.2: Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you live responsibly as a youth?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse
   In simple words: practise until you can identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour in the examples.
2. Explain Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour.
4. Show that you can: identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the meaning of human sexuality and share findings in class,
2. Research on forms of sexual abuse and make presentations using PowerPoint slides or charts,
3. List places or settings they should avoid for their own safety,
4. Discuss ways and where to report cases of sexual abuse,
5. Listen and ask a child protection officer (CPO) question(s) on what to do in case of defilement,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
